input.question: Which Kafka topics does the payment service publish to?
schema: Entity type JavaClass (label :JavaClass, category technical): A Java class. Properties: repository, fqcn, kind, path. Outgoing: DECLARES->JavaMethod. Incoming: .

Entity type JavaMethod (label :JavaMethod, category technical): A method. Properties: repository, fqcn, signature. Outgoing: PUBLISHES_TO->KafkaTopic, CALLS->JavaMethod. Incoming: JavaClass-DECLARES->.
Entity type KafkaTopic (label :KafkaTopic, category technical): A Kafka topic. Properties: name, placeholder. Outgoing: . Incoming: JavaMethod-PUBLISHES_TO->.

response.cypher: MATCH (m:JavaMethod)-[:PUBLISHES_TO]->(t:KafkaTopic) WHERE m.pke_id IN $seedIds RETURN DISTINCT t.pke_id AS id, 'KafkaTopic' AS type, t.name AS label, m.signature AS detail LIMIT 50
response.explanation: Kafka topics that the seed methods publish to, with the publishing method.
